# ABRIDGED BID NOTICE UNDER OPEN INTERNATIONAL BIDDING
Uganda Revenue Authority invites sealed bids from eligible bidders for:
Procurement Reference Number
Subject matter of Procurement
Bid Security
Prebid Meeting
Date of bid closing
URA/CUS/SUPLS/25-26/03796
Supply, Installation, Configuration and Commissioning of Non-Intrusive Inspection (NII) Body Scanners
UGX 12,000,000/=
22 nd May, 2026 at 10:00am
19 th June, 2026 at 10:00am
The Bidding document shall be inspected, issued and delivered at;
The Assistant Commissioner, Procurement and Disposal Division,
Uganda Revenue Authority
Plot M193/M194 Nakawa Industrial Area
P.O. Box 7279, Kampala, Uganda
13 th Floor, URA Tower
Tel 256(0)417442155/6/7/8/9
Fax 256(0)414334253
Email: ProcurementEnquiries@ura.go.ug
The deadline of bid submission shall be at 10:00am on 19 th June, 2026 at the address (2) above.
The bidding documents may be purchased by interested bidders on the submission of a written application letter to the address above at 2 and upon payment of a non-refundable fee of UGX: 100,000 . The method of payment will be EFT to any of the 21 banks authorized to receive Non-Tax Revenue fees on behalf of URA.
The detailed bid notice is available at the Entity’s website at www.ura.go.ug and at www.ppda.go.ug
Uganda Revenue Authority is regulated by the Public Procurement and Disposal of Public Assets Authority.
ACCOUNTING OFFICE
